string-array.name: mooncat_daily_verses
string-array.item: “The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing.”\n— Psalm 22:1
“I am the way, and the truth, and the life.”\n— John 14:6
“Come to me, all you that labour, and are burdened, and I will refresh you.”\n— Matthew 11:28
“I can do all these things in him who strengtheneth me.”\n— Philippians 4:13
“The Lord is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear?”\n— Psalm 26:1
“I am the light of the world: he that followeth me, walketh not in darkness, but shall have the light of life.”\n— John 8:12
“Blessed are the clean of heart: for they shall see God.”\n— Matthew 5:8
“Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.”\n— Matthew 5:9
“He that loveth not, knoweth not God: for God is charity.”\n— 1 John 4:8
“Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done to me according to thy word.”\n— Luke 1:38
“Seek ye therefore first the kingdom of God, and his justice, and all these things shall be added unto you.”\n— Matthew 6:33
“This is my commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you.”\n— John 15:12
“If God be for us, who is against us?”\n— Romans 8:31
“Thy word is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my paths.”\n— Psalm 118:105
“Behold I am with you all days, even to the consummation of the world.”\n— Matthew 28:20
“I am the resurrection and the life: he that believeth in me, although he be dead, shall live.”\n— John 11:25
“And now there remain faith, hope, and charity, these three: but the greatest of these is charity.”\n— 1 Corinthians 13:13
“Be still and see that I am God.”\n— Psalm 45:11
“Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you.”\n— Matthew 7:7
“A new commandment I give unto you: That you love one another, as I have loved you.”\n— John 13:34
“And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them in like manner.”\n— Luke 6:31
“O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: blessed is the man that hopeth in him.”\n— Psalm 33:9
“You are the light of the world.”\n— Matthew 5:14
“Fear not, for I am with thee: turn not aside, for I am thy God.”\n— Isaiah 41:10
“Have confidence in the Lord with all thy heart, and lean not upon thy own prudence.”\n— Proverbs 3:5
“I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall not hunger: and he that believeth in me shall never thirst.”\n— John 6:35
“Because no word shall be impossible with God.”\n— Luke 1:37
“Jesus Christ, yesterday, and to day; and the same for ever.”\n— Hebrews 13:8
“I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep.”\n— John 10:11
“Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.”\n— Matthew 22:39
“Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In all things give thanks.”\n— 1 Thessalonians 5:16–18
